title: Maikura Beacon Expansion
body:
# Maikura Beacon Expansion

Expand the power of beacons with extended range, advanced management tools, Construction Mode, item magnet effects, and beacon boundary visualization.

---

# Features

## Beacon Core

A special beacon enhancement block that extends beacon effect range up to **128 blocks**.

---

## Enhanced Beacon Core

An upgraded Beacon Core that extends beacon effect range up to **256 blocks** and unlocks advanced beacon functionality.

---

## Advanced Beacon Management

Enable or disable beacon effects individually through an easy-to-use management interface.

Includes advanced settings for Construction Mode, Item Magnet, and various utility effects.

---

## Construction Mode

Quickly remove building blocks while Construction Mode is active.

Supports configurable construction range, container protection, ore protection, mod block protection, and optional unrestricted item handling for flexible building workflows.

Designed for large-scale construction, terraforming, and renovation projects.

---

## Building Range Extension

Increase the interaction distance for building and block placement.

Multiple upgrade levels allow players to work efficiently across large construction areas.

---

## Item Magnet

Automatically attract nearby dropped items with configurable magnet ranges.

Useful for large building projects, mining operations, and general item collection.

---

## Beacon Boundary Visualization

Display beacon effect boundaries directly in the world for easier planning and management.

Quickly identify the exact area covered by beacon effects.

---

## Utility Effects

Additional beacon upgrades provide various quality-of-life improvements, including:

* Villager Trading Support
* Enhanced Natural Regeneration
* Durability Protection
* Flight Support
* Fire Resistance
* Negative Effect Reduction

---

## Modern Configuration GUI

Manage beacon effects, construction settings, item magnet range, and utility features through a modern list-based interface.

All settings can be adjusted directly in-game without editing configuration files.

---

# Supported Version

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader

---

Part of the Maikura Workshop mod series.
